_doc: Voucher table. `affects_scoring` marks the few vouchers the scorer would need to know about; everything else is economy, shop or draw and matters to the advisor's judgment rather than to the arithmetic.

vouchers.name: Overstock
vouchers.description: Adds a fourth card slot to the shop.

vouchers.name: Overstock Plus
vouchers.description: Adds a fifth card slot to the shop.

vouchers.name: Clearance Sale
vouchers.description: All shop items are 25% cheaper.

vouchers.name: Liquidation
vouchers.description: All shop items are 50% cheaper.

vouchers.name: Hone
vouchers.description: Foil, Holographic and Polychrome cards appear twice as often.

vouchers.name: Glow Up
vouchers.description: Foil, Holographic and Polychrome cards appear four times as often.

vouchers.name: Reroll Surplus
vouchers.description: Rerolls cost $2 less.

vouchers.name: Reroll Glut
vouchers.description: Rerolls cost another $2 less.

vouchers.name: Crystal Ball
vouchers.description: Adds a consumable slot.

vouchers.name: Omen Globe
vouchers.description: Spectral cards may appear in Arcana Packs.

vouchers.name: Telescope
vouchers.description: Celestial Packs always contain the Planet card for your most-played poker hand.

vouchers.name: Observatory
vouchers.description: Planet cards held in your consumable slots multiply the Mult of their poker hand by 1.5.
vouchers.scorer_note: Needs the held-consumable list and the played hand type. Declared but not applied by core/scorer - a state with this voucher marks affected candidates non-exact rather than guessing.

vouchers.name: Grabber
vouchers.description: Permanently gain +1 hand per round.

vouchers.name: Nacho Tong
vouchers.description: Permanently gain another +1 hand per round.

vouchers.name: Wasteful
vouchers.description: Permanently gain +1 discard per round.

vouchers.name: Recyclomancy
vouchers.description: Permanently gain another +1 discard per round.

vouchers.name: Seed Money
vouchers.description: Raises the interest cap to $10 per round.

vouchers.name: Money Tree
vouchers.description: Raises the interest cap to $20 per round.

vouchers.name: Blank
vouchers.description: Does nothing at all.

vouchers.name: Antimatter
vouchers.description: Permanently gain +1 Joker slot.

vouchers.name: Magic Trick
vouchers.description: Playing cards can be bought from the shop.

vouchers.name: Illusion
vouchers.description: Playing cards in the shop may have an enhancement, edition or seal.

vouchers.name: Hieroglyph
vouchers.description: Reduces the ante by 1, and you gain one fewer hand per round.

vouchers.name: Petroglyph
vouchers.description: Reduces the ante by another 1, and you gain one fewer discard per round.

vouchers.name: Director's Cut
vouchers.description: Lets you reroll the Boss Blind once per ante for $10.

vouchers.name: Retcon
vouchers.description: Lets you reroll the Boss Blind as often as you like for $10 each.

vouchers.name: Paint Brush
vouchers.description: Increases hand size by 1.

vouchers.name: Palette
vouchers.description: Increases hand size by another 1.
